<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Sloth operating an excavator on a sunny construction site</title>
  <desc id="desc">A cartoon sloth in a hard hat and high-visibility vest calmly operates a yellow tracked excavator, digging a dirt pile. Animated elements include the excavator arm, steering wheel, tracks, blinking eyes, floating Zzz, exhaust puffs, clouds, and a bird.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7ec8ff"/>
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#c9ecff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f8e8b0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff7c2"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ffd84d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffb300" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e2b56b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8792e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dirtGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c98a3a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7a4a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="excBodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd54a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e0a800"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="excDarkGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0b400"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b88400"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="armGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f3c430"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d69200"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="trackGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#555"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#222"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#dff4ff" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8fd3ff" stop-opacity="0.65"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="vestGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff9a1f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff6a00"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hatGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f2b500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="cautionStripe" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="24" height="24" patternTransform="rotate(35)">
      <rect width="24" height="24" fill="#222"/>
      <rect width="12" height="24" fill="#ffd400"/>
    </pattern>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="puffBlur">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.2"/>
    </filter>
    <g id="cloudShape">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="46" ry="26" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.95"/>
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="-8" rx="34" ry="22" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.95"/>
      <ellipse cx="-30" cy="-6" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.95"/>
      <ellipse cx="8" cy="-18" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g id="trackTread">
      <rect x="-180" y="58" width="360" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#trackGrad)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="3"/>
      <g fill="#3a3a3a">
        <rect x="-160" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="-130" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="-100" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="-70" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="-40" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="-10" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="20" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="50" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="80" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="110" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
        <rect x="140" y="64" width="22" height="32" rx="3"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g transform="translate(1040 120)">
    <circle r="88" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
    <circle r="42" fill="#ffd84d" stroke="#ffef9a" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g stroke="#ffcf40" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="0" y1="-68" x2="0" y2="-92"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="68" x2="0" y2="92"/>
      <line x1="-68" y1="0" x2="-92" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="68" y1="0" x2="92" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="-48" y1="-48" x2="-66" y2="-66"/>
      <line x1="48" y1="-48" x2="66" y2="-66"/>
      <line x1="-48" y1="48" x2="-66" y2="66"/>
      <line x1="48" y1="48" x2="66" y2="66"/>
    </g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 1040 120" to="360 1040 120" dur="30s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g opacity="0.92">
    <g transform="translate(140 140)">
      <use href="#cloudShape"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="140 140; 170 140; 140 140" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(430 95) scale(1.1)">
      <use href="#cloudShape"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="430 95; 460 95; 430 95" dur="16s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(760 165) scale(0.9)">
      <use href="#cloudShape"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="760 165; 790 165; 760 165" dur="14s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bird crossing the sky -->
  <g stroke="#3b4a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M0 0 q8 -8 16 0 q8 -8 16 0"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-60 180; 1260 150" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#3b4a5a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
    <path d="M0 0 q6 -6 12 0 q6 -6 12 0"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-120 220; 1220 205" dur="22s" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Distant hills -->
  <path d="M0 430 C 180 360, 320 470, 520 420 C 720 360, 860 470, 1200 410 L1200 520 L0 520 Z" fill="#d9c07a" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="500" width="1200" height="300" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="620" cy="520" rx="520" ry="48" fill="#f0c978" opacity="0.45"/>

  <!-- Dirt pile -->
  <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <path d="M700 620 C 760 540, 860 525, 940 585 C 1005 560, 1090 590, 1125 640 C 1155 675, 1120 700, 1060 705 L760 705 C 700 700, 665 665, 700 620 Z" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>
    <path d="M760 655 C 820 610, 890 610, 940 650" fill="none" stroke="#915f25" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    <path d="M865 635 C 925 605, 995 620, 1035 655" fill="none" stroke="#915f25" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rocks and construction details -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="675" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#8f8f8f"/>
    <ellipse cx="268" cy="682" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#777"/>
    <ellipse cx="1045" cy="690" rx="18" ry="11" fill="#888"/>
    <ellipse cx="1072" cy="695" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#747474"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Caution barrier -->
  <g transform="translate(95 590)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="190" height="26" rx="4" fill="url(#cautionStripe)" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="12" y="26" width="12" height="88" fill="#555"/>
    <rect x="166" y="26" width="12" height="88" fill="#555"/>
    <rect x="6" y="108" width="24" height="8" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
    <rect x="160" y="108" width="24" height="8" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Traffic cone -->
  <g transform="translate(330 625)">
    <rect x="-34" y="58" width="68" height="10" rx="3" fill="#333"/>
    <path d="M-22 58 L0 0 L22 58 Z" fill="#ff7a18" stroke="#d85c00" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-14" y="22" width="28" height="8" fill="#fff7df" opacity="0.95"/>
    <rect x="-18" y="38" width="36" height="8" fill="#fff7df" opacity="0.95"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(1160 635) scale(0.9)">
    <rect x="-34" y="58" width="68" height="10" rx="3" fill="#333"/>
    <path d="M-22 58 L0 0 L22 58 Z" fill="#ff7a18" stroke="#d85c00" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-14" y="22" width="28" height="8" fill="#fff7df" opacity="0.95"/>
    <rect x="-18" y="38" width="36" height="8" fill="#fff7df" opacity="0.95"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Excavator group -->
  <g id="excavator" transform="translate(470 505)" filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <!-- Tracks (rolling) -->
    <g id="tracks" transform="translate(0 118)">
      <use href="#trackTread"/>
      <g fill="#777" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3">
        <!-- rollers -->
        <g>
          <circle cx="-120" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="-120" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <circle cx="-70" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="-70" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <circle cx="-20" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="-20" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <circle cx="30" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="30" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <circle cx="130" cy="80" r="18" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
          <circle cx="130" cy="80" r="7" fill="#444"/>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 0 80; 360 0 80" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </g>
        <!-- sprockets -->
        <circle cx="-155" cy="80" r="20" fill="#666"/>
        <circle cx="-155" cy="80" r="8" fill="#333"/>
        <circle cx="155" cy="80" r="20" fill="#666"/>
        <circle cx="155" cy="80" r="8" fill="#333"/>
      </g>
      <!-- tread motion illusion -->
      <g opacity="0.35" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2">
        <line x1="-180" y1="80" x2="180" y2="80">
          <animate attributeName="stroke-dasharray" values="10 14;14 10;10 14" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="0;-24;0" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Upper rotating body -->
    <g id="upperBody" transform="translate(0 0)">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-1 40 90; 1 40 90; -1 40 90" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <!-- platform -->
      <rect x="-95" y="62" width="260" height="60" rx="10" fill="url(#excDarkGrad)" stroke="#8a6500" stroke-width="3"/>
      <ellipse cx="35" cy="92" rx="62" ry="18" fill="#cb9100" opacity="0.55"/>

      <!-- Arm assembly (digging cycle) -->
      <g id="armAssembly" transform="translate(135 85)">
        <!-- boom -->
        <g id="boom" transform="rotate(-18)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-18; -10; -24; -18" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.75;1" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <path d="M0 -10 L170 -52 L186 -28 L20 16 Z" fill="url(#armGrad)" stroke="#9a6800" stroke-width="3"/>
          <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="15" fill="#777" stroke="#444" stroke-width="3"/>
          <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#444"/>
          <!-- stick pivoted at boom end -->
          <g id="stick" transform="translate(176 -40) rotate(52)">
            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="52; 68; 30; 52" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.75;1" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <path d="M0 -8 L150 18 L142 40 L-8 14 Z" fill="url(#armGrad)" stroke="#9a6800" stroke-width="3"/>
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12" fill="#777" stroke="#444" stroke-width="3"/>
            <!-- bucket -->
            <g id="bucket" transform="translate(146 28) rotate(-35)">
              <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-35; -5; -78; -35" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.75;1" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <path d="M0 0 L54 8 C 58 28, 40 48, 14 48 L-8 34 Z" fill="#6f7680" stroke="#4b5058" stroke-width="3"/>
              <path d="M4 10 L48 16 L22 38 Z" fill="#8b929b" opacity="0.7"/>
              <g fill="#596068">
                <path d="M-2 28 l-8 12 l10 2 z"/>
                <path d="M10 34 l-6 14 l10 0 z"/>
                <path d="M24 38 l-3 14 l10 -2 z"/>
                <path d="M38 40 l0 14 l10 -5 z"/>
                <path d="M50 24 l4 12 l8 -8 z"/>
              </g>
              <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#666" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>
            </g>
            <!-- hydraulic line hint -->
            <path d="M15 2 C 60 -12, 95 -2, 130 12" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55"/>
          </g>
          <path d="M20 -8 C 70 -28, 110 -38, 150 -36" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5"/>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- Cab -->
      <g id="cab">
        <rect x="-78" y="-18" width="155" height="95" rx="10" fill="url(#excBodyGrad)" stroke="#9a6800" stroke-width="3"/>
        <rect x="-92" y="-4" width="22" height="70" rx="6" fill="#dca000" stroke="#9a6800" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="-58" y="-8" width="118" height="58" rx="8" fill="url(#glassGrad)" stroke="#5f8fa8" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="2" y1="-8" x2="2" y2="50" stroke="#7fb5cc" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.8"/>
        <rect x="-70" y="55" width="138" height="12" rx="4" fill="#cf9300"/>
        <!-- exhaust pipe -->
        <g transform="translate(70 -18)">
          <rect x="-5" y="-42" width="10" height="44" rx="3" fill="#555" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
          <rect x="-9" y="-48" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
          <!-- exhaust puffs -->
          <g filter="url(#puffBlur)">
            <circle cx="0" cy="-56" r="5" fill="#d9dde2" opacity="0">
              <animate attributeName="cy" values="-56;-92" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="r" values="4;11" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.55;0" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            </circle>
            <circle cx="4" cy="-56" r="4" fill="#d9dde2" opacity="0">
              <animate attributeName="cy" values="-56;-100" dur="3.2s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="cx" values="4;14" dur="3.2s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="r" values="3;10" dur="3.2s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.45;0" dur="3.2s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            </circle>
            <circle cx="-2" cy="-56" r="4" fill="#d9dde2" opacity="0">
              <animate attributeName="cy" values="-56;-88" dur="3.2s" begin="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="cx" values="-2;6" dur="3.2s" begin="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="r" values="3;9" dur="3.2s" begin="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.5;0" dur="3.2s" begin="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            </circle>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- Engine housing -->
      <rect x="62" y="10" width="92" height="60" rx="8" fill="#d89d00" stroke="#9a6800" stroke-width="3"/>
      <g stroke="#b07c00" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="72" y1="24" x2="144" y2="24"/>
        <line x1="72" y1="36" x2="144" y2="36"/>
        <line x1="72" y1="48" x2="144" y2="48"/>
        <line x1="72" y1="60" x2="144" y2="60"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Sloth in cab -->
      <g id="sloth" transform="translate(-18 16)">
        <!-- body / vest -->
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="34" rx="28" ry="24" fill="#8c6847"/>
        <path d="M-22 18 C -24 36, -16 54, 0 56 C 16 54, 24 36, 22 18 Z" fill="url(#vestGrad)" stroke="#d45500" stroke-width="2"/>
        <g fill="#d9ecff" opacity="0.95">
          <rect x="-18" y="24" width="36" height="5" rx="2"/>
          <rect x="-18" y="34" width="36" height="5" rx="2"/>
        </g>
        <rect x="-3" y="18" width="6" height="38" fill="#ffcf66" opacity="0.55"/>

        <!-- arm to steering wheel -->
        <g stroke="#8c6847" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
          <path d="M16 30 C 36 34, 52 42, 64 50"/>
        </g>
        <g fill="#7a5738">
          <rect x="60" y="46" width="4" height="8" rx="1"/>
          <rect x="65" y="46" width="4" height="8" rx="1"/>
          <rect x="70" y="47" width="4" height="7" rx="1"/>
        </g>

        <!-- head -->
        <g transform="translate(0 -2)">
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="2" rx="24" ry="21" fill="#b08968"/>
          <!-- face mask -->
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="6" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#ead7c3"/>
          <!-- eye patches -->
          <ellipse cx="-9" cy="2" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#6d4c41"/>
          <ellipse cx="9" cy="2" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#6d4c41"/>
          <!-- eyes: half-closed content, with blink -->
          <g id="eyes">
            <path d="M-13 3 q4 -3 8 0" fill="none" stroke="#2b1d18" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <path d="M5 3 q4 -3 8 0" fill="none" stroke="#2b1d18" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <circle cx="-9" cy="3.2" r="1.2" fill="#2b1d18"/>
            <circle cx="9" cy="3.2" r="1.2" fill="#2b1d18"/>
            <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;1;1;0;1" keyTimes="0;0.72;0.78;0.84;0.88;1" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </g>
          <g opacity="0">
            <line x1="-13" y1="3" x2="-5" y2="3" stroke="#2b1d18" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <line x1="5" y1="3" x2="13" y2="3" stroke="#2b1d18" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;0;0;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.72;0.78;0.84;0.88;1" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </g>
          <!-- nose and sleepy smile -->
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="8" rx="3.2" ry="2.4" fill="#5d4037"/>
          <path d="M-6 12 q6 5 12 0" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <!-- rosy cheeks -->
          <ellipse cx="-15" cy="10" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#f2a7a1" opacity="0.55"/>
          <ellipse cx="15" cy="10" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#f2a7a1" opacity="0.55"/>

          <!-- hard hat -->
          <g transform="translate(0 -16)">
            <ellipse cx="0" cy="10" rx="27" ry="6" fill="#d9a100"/>
            <path d="M-22 10 C -20 -6, -8 -14, 0 -14 C 8 -14, 20 -6, 22 10 Z" fill="url(#hatGrad)" stroke="#c99200" stroke-width="2"/>
            <rect x="-5" y="-12" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffe680" opacity="0.85"/>
          </g>
        </g>

        <!-- other arm resting -->
        <path d="M-18 34 C -34 40, -38 50, -30 54" fill="none" stroke="#8c6847" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

        <!-- Zzz drifting to sleep -->
        <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-weight="700" fill="#355c7d">
          <text x="18" y="-18" font-size="14" opacity="0">Z
            <animate attributeName="y" values="-18;-52" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="x" values="18;28" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.9;0" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </text>
          <text x="30" y="-8" font-size="18" opacity="0">Z
            <animate attributeName="y" values="-8;-48" dur="3.6s" begin="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="x" values="30;44" dur="3.6s" begin="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.95;0" dur="3.6s" begin="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </text>
          <text x="42" y="2" font-size="22" opacity="0">Z
            <animate attributeName="y" values="2;-44" dur="3.6s" begin="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="x" values="42;60" dur="3.6s" begin="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="3.6s" begin="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </text>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- Steering wheel (turning) -->
      <g id="steeringWheel" transform="translate(44 34)">
        <circle r="17" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
        <circle r="4.5" fill="#444"/>
        <rect x="-2" y="-15" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
        <rect x="-2" y="3" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
        <rect x="-15" y="-2" width="12" height="4" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
        <rect x="3" y="-2" width="12" height="4" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
